Final matchScore=0.5578 (clamped 0–1).

Score breakdown (transparent weights):
- Name/alias coherence 0.2806 (weight 0.5): mean Jaccard 0.2000, mean Levenshtein-normalized 0.3611.
  Evaluated 2 alias(es) against displayName using 0.5*Jaccard(tokens)+0.5*LevenshteinNorm(full string).
- AttributeSignals 0.7700 (weight 0.25): AttributeSignals (1) strengthen identity context.
  AttributeSignals used: nationality:MX
- Confidence prior 0.9000 (weight 0.25) from entity.confidence.score.

Conflict rule: alias pairs with combined similarity < 0.40 (strategy-adjusted).
Conflicts: 1 low-similarity alias(es) flagged; canonical displayName retained. Correlation: week3-apex-demo-001.

[Combo/high_velocity_syndicate] Behavioral velocity (session_length, bet_velocity_7d, stake_ramp) converging with fraud markers (chargeback_history_90d, disputed_deposits_90d, ato_signals) — fast-burn syndicate shape; cap bet_velocity, lock high-value payouts, and pull device_fingerprint / shared_ip_cluster overlap before manual clearance.
[Gaming-P1] Escalate immediately to fraud-ops + AML leadership; suspend wallet funding, bonus issuance, and withdrawals until a named analyst clears the case.
